documentation.content:
The Cloud SQL instance's disk is over 90% used and autoresize has not caught up, or has been capped. Autoresize adds space when a threshold is crossed, so sustained 90% means either the cap (`settings.storageAutoResizeLimit`) was set or growth is faster than the resize cycle: check `disk/bytes_used` over the last day and the disk-growth alert.

`gcloud sql instances describe loop-sessions --format='value(settings.dataDiskSizeGb,settings.storageAutoResizeLimit)'`. Raising the cap or the size is `gcloud sql instances patch loop-sessions --storage-size=<GB>`, and a patch that changes storage does not restart the instance.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-cloudsql
